applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Use the platform's card-payment or advertising billing entry. This is different from binding a bank account to receive marketplace payouts.

For Amazon UK, US, Turkey and other supported sites, compare the card billing address, postcode and street information with the platform record. If the details match but binding fails, obtain the error for investigation. For Amazon Mexico cross-currency MXN timeouts, a same-currency payment after obtaining MXN can be attempted.

For eBay, contact the platform about its review of the attempted card binding. Walmart advertising uses the advertising-management payment-method page. Supported Shopee card sites include Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines and Thailand; support on another site must be checked separately.

Mexican platform forms may request the holder's INE or IFE identifier. Supply the actual holder information required by the platform. An urgent payment may use another accepted card or payment method while a binding error is investigated.
